name: eom-forces-default
label: Extraocular muscle force capacity for the insertion-force export (Milestone 4)
equation: forceN = activation x maxForceN, activation from the length proxy (data/eom/activation.json); an approximation

lateralRectus.citation: Collins, Carlson et al., Extraocular muscle forces in normal human subjects, Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 1981 (PubMed 7216678): mean active fixation force at 50 deg extreme gaze, 29 subjects aged 18-33 (excerpt); individual maxima ranged 48-103 gf.

medialRectus.citation: Collins et al. 1981, as for the lateral rectus (excerpt).

superiorRectus.citation: derived: the mean of Collins et al. 1981's horizontal recti (66.95 gf) times this muscle's ratio to the horizontal mean in the active tensions of Shin et al., Applied Sciences 13(20):11431, 2023 (swab-and-force-sensor device; lateral 101.7 +/- 15.0, medial 88.0 +/- 15.4, inferior 61.3 +/- 6.8, superior 121.3 +/- 38.5 g; excerpt): 121.3 / 94.85 = 1.2789. Shin's absolute values exceed the 45-60 g of earlier studies (the authors attribute it to the passive connective tissue their method includes), so only the ratio is used, to keep the Collins scale of the horizontal recti.

inferiorRectus.citation: derived: the mean of Collins et al. 1981's horizontal recti (66.95 gf) times this muscle's ratio to the horizontal mean in the active tensions of Shin et al., Applied Sciences 13(20):11431, 2023 (swab-and-force-sensor device; lateral 101.7 +/- 15.0, medial 88.0 +/- 15.4, inferior 61.3 +/- 6.8, superior 121.3 +/- 38.5 g; excerpt): 61.3 / 94.85 = 0.6463. Shin's absolute values exceed the 45-60 g of earlier studies (the authors attribute it to the passive connective tissue their method includes), so only the ratio is used, to keep the Collins scale of the horizontal recti.

superiorOblique.citation: assumption: equal to the lateral rectus (no excerpt gave oblique forces).

inferiorOblique.citation: assumption: equal to the lateral rectus (no excerpt gave oblique forces).

insertionFootprintLengthMm.citation: assumption: the extent along the pull direction over which a tendon's force is spread on the sclera at its insertion (the insertion line is a narrow band; the FEM needs a finite footprint).

note: Collins et al. report force at extreme gaze, which this model takes as activation 1; with the activation table's primary-position baseline (0.2) a horizontal rectus carries about 12-15 gf in primary position.
